name: Psi+
description: Psi+'s reviewed CMake configuration leaves USE_SPARKLE off by default. When enabled for Apple builds, the project creates a Sparkle SUUpdater, sets its feed URL, and checks in the background; the reviewed integration contains no visible pinned Sparkle public-key setting. Framework and released-artifact verification remain unresolved.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The reviewed project source does not establish Sparkle framework version, release feed contents, or independent release signing.
